clusters.name: inner-marker-audit
clusters.executionModeRationale: Run first because the wrapper registry must describe the final marker anchor set. Source edits are comment-only but live in the inner submodule and require a separate commit.

clusters.name: wrapper-registry-refresh
clusters.executionModeRationale: Serialize after marker audit because this cluster updates the single large registry file and must encode the marker decisions and stale-row retirements accurately.

clusters.name: validation-and-handoff
clusters.executionModeRationale: Run last because validation must inspect both the inner marker commit and wrapper registry commit. It is command-driven and should not run in parallel with edits to the audited files.
